# Everni

> Everni is a native Shopify app for subscriptions and recurring billing, built in Brazil (B2C, D2C and B2B). It covers subscription plans, recurring billing, failed payment recovery and retention, a self-serve customer portal and recurring revenue analytics. Pricing: free to install, then a flat 1% of monthly subscription GMV on the Growth plan, with no monthly fee and no per-order fee, billed in USD through Shopify. An Enterprise plan with negotiated rates is available for high-volume brands. Free assisted migration from Recharge, Skio, other apps or spreadsheets, with a 30-day pilot.

Everni é um app de assinaturas e cobrança recorrente nativo da Shopify, feito no Brasil. Instalação gratuita e plano Growth com taxa única de 1% do GMV mensal de assinaturas, sem mensalidade e sem taxa por pedido; plano Enterprise com condições negociadas para alto volume. Parceira oficial no Brasil: Stone. Também integra Barte, Stripe, PayPal, Shopify Payments e Authorize.net.

## Key facts
- Plans: Growth (1% of monthly subscription GMV, free to install, no monthly fee, no per-order fee) and Enterprise (custom pricing).
- Growth includes: Subscription plans by product, frequency and discount; Subscribe-and-save on native Shopify checkout; Automated recurring billing every cycle; Failed payment recovery with automatic retries and customer alerts; Cancellation flow with save offers; Automated subscriber emails; Self-serve customer portal: skip, pause, swap, change frequency and update payment method; Upsells in the customer portal; Tiered discounts; B2B subscriptions; Multi-language and multi-currency with Shopify Markets; API and webhooks; Analytics for MRR, retained revenue and cohort retention.
- Enterprise adds: 24/7 support; Dedicated success manager; Direct input on the roadmap; Early access; Custom development; Volume pricing.
- Payment providers: Shopify Payments, Stripe, PayPal and Authorize.net (US, Canada, Europe); Stone (official partner) and Barte (Brazil).
- Migration: free and assisted, from Recharge, Skio, other apps or spreadsheets, with a 30-day pilot.
- Last updated: 2026-11-25.

Company: L.V.M. Alexandrino (CNPJ 32.086.364/0001-22), R. Dom Barreto, 692 - Paraíso, Americana/SP, Brazil. Developed by AM Lab (https://amlab.com.br). Contact: contato@amlab.com.br · WhatsApp +55 11 95506-1996.
